label: Click the browser live action button and verify status

intent.summary: Click the browser live action commit button and verify that the status output changes.
intent.purpose: Prove a Step Descriptor can describe the existing AOS browser click/status evidence bridge without becoming the Work Record run evidence.
intent.acceptance: A generated Work Record validates, preserves origin.kind workflow, and verifies the promoted status-change Claim through the report-only verifier.
constraints: Use AOS browser Target-with-Ref addresses instead of raw Playwright selectors.
Re-see and re-resolve the semantic target before any caller-selected future execution.
Keep replay and repair behind explicit caller-selected workflows.

preconditions.description: The before perception exposes the Live action status output in the Ready state.

repair_policy.notes: If the status ref drifts, patch the precondition ref or locator hints after fresh source validation.

postconditions.description: The after perception shows the Live action status output changed to Action recorded.

repair_policy.notes: If the status ref or value path drifts, patch the execution-map postcondition rather than editing the promoted Claim text.

repair_hints.note: Re-run see under the fresh target validation and patch target_resolution candidate hints if e2 no longer resolves.
Patch the status postcondition ref or value path under the repair proposal if the browser facet changes.

claim_promotions.claim_text: The bounded AOS browser click changed the live action status to Action recorded.
claim_promotions.acceptance: After perception semantic target e3 contains Action recorded.
